column1: # Thinking ablation summary: damage (constrained-free; damage_se = UNPAIRED binomial SE of the difference, n per task) and lengths per model/mode/arm/task. Producer: analysis/residency/think_analysis.py

# Every cell is reported at the largest generation budget fair to both of its arms (see FAIR and resolve). budget_free and budget_con are the budgets actually used, caphit_free and caphit_con the percent of that arms generations ending within 8 tokens of it, and record names the source record. A cap-hit above 2 percent means the cell is still budget-limited and its damage carries a truncation component.
